tools.name: get_week_board
tools.description: Full public board for one NFL week (regular season weeks 1–18). Optional weekId. Omit it for the  current week, the same week as the homepage. After the last Week 18 kickoff window the current week stays on 18. Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call is the weather call. chip is the kic

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One game. Pass team (a code such as BUF or NE) or gameId (such as 2026-w04-ne-buf). Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. A gameId selects that game's week when weekId is omitted. Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call is the weather call. chip is the kickoff ±2h threshold ch

tools.name: get_flags
tools.description: Games whose call is FLAG or WATCH. Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call is the weather call. chip is the kickoff ±2h threshold check and does not replace the call. afterTip is a quiet note, not a flag. roof.status on a retractable game

tools.name: get_report_card
tools.description: A published Sideline report card, the same cards as /report-cards. Optional weekId (YYYY-wNN). Omit it for the newest published card. The response includes season-to-date totals. Grades are historical. For the live weather call, use get_game and Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call
